newsitem.title: USA: U.S. tobacco settlement seen next week--source.
newsitem.headline: U.S. tobacco settlement seen next week--source.

text.p: State attorneys general negotiating a settlement with the tobacco industry expect to reach an agreement with cigarette companies next week, a source close to the talks said on Wednesday.
The source told Reuters the negotiators were "very upbeat" following a two-hour telephone conference call in which they updated top state officials on progress in the talks.
Negotiators said Tuesday that a sticking issue was how much control the Food and Drug Administration should have over nicotine in cigarettes.
The source said the negotiators were optimistic that they could soon reach an agreement about language on nicotine control.

On Tuesday, negotiators said they were recessing the talks because of a Jewish holiday. They denied published reports that the session had ended because of an impasse over the nicotine issue. Thye said another meeting would be set next week, possibly as soon as Monday.
